# A Canadian company that buys US dollars, and later sells them and buys more.
#
# The first half of a book for asking what a balance sheet drawn at an earlier
# date states. Import this, then
# `the_usd_sold_and_rebought_at_a_higher_rate.txt` on top of it.
#
# - 2026-01-02  10,000.00 CAD of opening capital.
# - 2026-01-10  1,000.00 USD bought at 1.30, so 1,300.00 CAD leaves the bank
#               and a cost basis of 1,000.00 USD opens at that cost.
#
# Prices, all at 12:00 UTC: USD in CAD 1.30 on 01-10, 1.35 on 06-30 and 1.50
# on 08-01. The 06-30 price is what a sheet drawn at the half year prices the
# holding by, and the whole point of the pair: on that date the book holds the
# January dollars and nothing else, so its gain is 1,350.00 against 1,300.00
# of cost — 50.00 CAD.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Opening balances
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-01-10 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "13/10"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-06-30 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "27/20"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-08-01 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "3/2"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

2026-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 10000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening balances -10000.00 CAD

2026-01-10 * "Buy 1,000.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 1000.00 USD
		share_price: "1.30"
		value: "1300.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -1300.00 CAD
